summary: Cumberland County steel tower listed as 99 ft 9 in and built by the CCC in 1934; no source says whether it still stands, and a 2026 radio-site notice does not name it.

facts.agency: North Carolina Division of Forest Resources

events.note: 99-foot 9-inch steel tower constructed by the CCC, per the North Carolina forest lookout listing.

evidence.supports: The Cedar Creek tower is listed as built by the CCC in 1934 and as a 99-foot 9-inch steel tower.
evidence.quote: 1934: A 99-foot 9-inch steel tower constructed by the CCC.

evidence.supports: The listing files Cedar Creek under Cumberland County and the North Carolina Division of Forest Resources.
evidence.quote: Cumberland County - North Carolina Division of Forest Resources

evidence.supports: A list of North Carolina towers places Cedar Creek in Cumberland County.
A 2026 state notice describes the Cedar Creek Tower Site at 7109 Cedar Creek Road in Fayetteville.
evidence.quote: the Cedar Creek Tower Site located at 7109 Cedar Creek Road, Fayetteville, NC 28312

evidence.supports: The State Highway Patrol maintains the statewide VIPER voice network.
evidence.quote: The North Carolina State Highway Patrol is responsible for constructing and maintaining the statewide voice interoperable communications network

evidence.supports: The notice calls for an old tower site to be decommissioned after its equipment moves to a new site.
evidence.quote: Decommission the old tower site after relocating all equipment to the new site

sources.title: VIPER Cedar Creek Site Construction and Old Tower Decommissioning in Cumberland County, NC

notes_for_editor: The 1934 date and 99 ft 9 in height come from one uncited line in a hobbyist listing; no status, access, or staffing found. The HigherGov notice is a State procurement for a Cedar Creek Tower Site at 7109 Cedar Creek Road, Fayetteville; it does not say whether that is this lookout, so the story does not link them. WM1998 (Waymarking) returned only its title and anyplaceamerica returned HTTP 403, so neither was read. Record status and access stay unknown; no correction proposed.
